fields.description: API key from console.anthropic.com. Used by all AI features in the app.
fields.label: API Key

fields.description: Required for organization-scoped API keys. Find it in the Anthropic Console under Settings → Workspaces.
fields.label: Workspace ID

fields.description: Default Claude model for AI features.
fields.label: Default Model

fields.options:
Configure your Anthropic API credentials here. These settings are used by all AI features in the app, including document import.

Get an API key from console.anthropic.com. If your key is organization-scoped (not tied to a specific workspace), you'll also need to enter the Workspace ID.

fields.description: Tokens all AI features together may use each calendar month (input, output and cached). 0 means no budget.
fields.label: Monthly Token Budget

fields.description: Stop the inventory assistant and document import once this month's budget is used up.
fields.label: Stop AI Features When Budget Is Used

fields.options:
Every request to Claude is recorded in AI Usage Log. The Inventory Assistant shows how much of this month's budget is left.

This budget is kept by this app. Your Anthropic account's own spend limit and credit balance are on the Billing page of the Claude Console.
